steps.name: Given TPP have a valid PayPal access token
When TPP create a checkout order using data from excel for "ORDER_5"
Then TPP check order is succesfully created with "200"
And TPP confirm the checkout order and response code should be "200" and "ORDER_5"
Then TPP redirect PSU to login on paypal  to approve the order with "tom@gmail.com" and "joe@123"
